info.title: EventPro Platform API
info.description: REST API for EventPro event ticketing platform

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

put.description: Updates the profile of the currently authenticated user
Updates an event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.
Updates an add-on. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

delete.description: Deletes an add-on. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

put.description: Updates user information. Requires ADMIN role.

post.description: Uploads a profile picture for the current user
Promotes a user to ORGANIZER role. Users can only be promoted to ORGANIZER.
Creates multiple tickets for an event. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role. Each TicketInfo in the request creates the specified quantity of tickets.
Creates a Stripe payment intent for the specified amount. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Confirms a Stripe payment and creates an order from the user's cart. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Checks in an attendee by ticket ID. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns events created by the authenticated organizer. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

post.description: Creates a new event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.
Creates tickets for an event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns add-ons (enhancements) for an event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

post.description: Creates an add-on (enhancement) for an event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.
Uploads an image for an event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.

get.description: Retrieves orders for the authenticated user, or all orders if admin. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role. Supports pagination.

post.description: Creates an order from the authenticated user's cart. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role. The cart will be cleared after order creation.
Requests a refund for an order. Users can only refund their own orders. Admins can refund any order. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.

get.description: Returns paginated list of PUBLISHED events. Supports search by keyword (name). Public endpoint - only shows published events.

post.description: Creates a new event with optional image upload. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role. Content-Type must be multipart/form-data with 'request' (JSON string) and optional 'imageFile' parts.
Changes event status from DRAFT to PUBLISHED. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role. Validates that event has required data (image, address) before publishing.
Adds multiple tickets to the authenticated user's cart in batch. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role. Each item should specify ticketTypeId (ticket UUID or event UUID) and quantity.
Adds a ticket to the authenticated user's cart. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role. Can specify ticket by UUID or by event ID + ticket type.
Sends a confirmation email after password reset with the verification code.
Authenticates user and returns a JWT access token.

get.description: Returns ticket details by ID. Public endpoint.

delete.description: Deletes a ticket by ID. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role.

patch.description: Updates an existing ticket. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role. All fields are optional.

get.description: Returns event details by ID. Public endpoint.

delete.description: Deletes an event by ID. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role.

patch.description: Updates an existing event. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role. All fields are optional. imageFile can be provided as a query parameter. Can update status field.
Updates the quantity of a specific item in the cart. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Updates user status. Requires ADMIN role.
Updates user role. Requires ADMIN role.
Updates the status of an event. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns paginated list of all users (admin only)
Returns user profile by ID (admin only)
Downloads a ticket as PDF with QR code. Users can only download their own tickets. Admins can download any ticket. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Returns tickets for an event grouped by ticket type. Public endpoint.
Returns a summary of event tickets with counts by type. Public endpoint.
Returns all tickets for a specific event. Public endpoint.
Returns statistics for an event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.
Returns attendees for an event. Requires ORGANIZER or ADMIN role.
Retrieves an order by its ID. Users can only access their own orders. Admins can access any order. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Retrieves orders for a specific user. Users can only access their own orders. Admins can access any user's orders. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role. Supports pagination.
Retrieves orders for the authenticated user. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role. Supports pagination.
Streams an image from S3 by key or full URL. Use when direct S3 URL returns 403 (e.g. LocalStack).
Returns ticket types with availability information for an event. Public endpoint.
Returns add-ons (enhancements, merchandise, upgrades) for an event. Public endpoint.
Returns all events (draft and published) created by the authenticated organizer. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role.
Returns draft events created by the authenticated organizer. Requires ADMIN or ORGANIZER role.
Returns events where the authenticated user has purchased tickets. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Returns list of PUBLISHED events in the specified category. Uses category name, not ID. Public endpoint - only shows published events.
Returns all event categories. Public endpoint.
Retrieves all items in the authenticated user's cart. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Returns all users (admin view). Requires ADMIN role.
Returns platform-wide statistics. Requires ADMIN role.
Returns revenue data for a time period. Requires ADMIN role.
Returns all events (admin view). Requires ADMIN role.
Returns sales data for all events. Requires ADMIN role.

delete.description: Removes a specific item from the authenticated user's cart. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
Removes all items from the authenticated user's cart. Requires USER, ADMIN, or ORGANIZER role.
